providers.behavior: Authenticates user with Google. If first login, creates initial user profile doc in 'users/{uid}' with role=null and onboardingComplete=false; redirects to /role-select. If admin email (mukvr46@gmail.com) and redirect=/admin, directs straight to admin portal.

Validates email and password. If credentials match, signs in. If user not found, automatically falls back to createUserWithEmailAndPassword (smart onboarding). If admin email (mukvr46@gmail.com), forwards to /admin.
Creates new Firebase Auth user account, initializes users/{uid} document with default fields, redirects to /role-select.
Dispatches Firebase password reset email. Renders success confirmation message in UI.
Invokes RecaptchaVerifier and dispatches SMS OTP. User enters 6-digit confirmation code. Verified phone number is saved to users/{uid}.phone and users/{uid}.phoneVerified = true.
Links verified phone credential to existing Google/Email account.

signOut.behavior: Clears auth token, resets Zustand store (resetAll), redirects user to '/'.

authenticated_pending_onboarding.description: User logged in but has not finished role selection or onboarding quiz
authenticated_pending_onboarding.guardAction: OnboardingGuard redirects incomplete users to /role-select or /onboarding/{role}

seeker.description: Fully onboarded room seeker looking for accommodation or flatmates

owner.description: Fully onboarded property owner or owner-flatmate with space to rent

admin.description: Platform administrator authorized via admins/{email} document or hardcoded list
admin.authorizationRules: firestore.rules: isAdmin() requires doc at admins/{email} OR lowercased auth email in ['mukvr46@gmail.com', 'admin@nestmate.in', 'admin@nestmate-test.com'].

accountStatusStates.active: Full normal system access according to role.
accountStatusStates.suspended: Temporary restriction by admin. BlockedAccountScreen displayed with reason message. Direct writes blocked by firestore.rules isActiveUser().
accountStatusStates.banned: Permanent account termination by admin. BlockedAccountScreen displayed. All write operations permanently denied.

routeGuards.name: OnboardingGuard
routeGuards.condition: isAuthenticated && isAccountActive(status) && onboardingComplete && (expectedRole ? role === expectedRole : true)

routeGuards.name: AdminRedirectWatcher
routeGuards.onSuccess: Normalizes URL to /admin with query parameters

routeGuards.name: AdminGate (AdminLayout)
routeGuards.onFailure: Redirects non-logged-in users to /login?redirect=/admin, and non-admin logged-in users to /dashboard or /owner-dashboard
